// A miniature field document.

= 1. Terminology

ALWAYS use "analytic" — NEVER "holomorphic" or "regular".

ALWAYS write "an entire function" — NEVER "entire" as a
standalone adjective without "function".

ALWAYS use "mapping" — NEVER "transformation" for the act of
applying $f$.

ALWAYS use "linear fractional transformation".
NEVER use "Möbius transformation".

= 2. Two-sentence rulings are proposals, not rulings

ALWAYS use "branch cut" (two words, no hyphen).
ALWAYS use "branch point" (two words, no hyphen).
NEVER write "branchcut" or "branch-cut".

= 3. Notation

ALWAYS write $overline(z)$ — NEVER $z^*$.
